seriesTitle: Elite Short Stories: Omar Ander Alexis

episodes.title: Parte 1
episodes.summary: After Ander and Omar pay a visit to a defeated Alexis at the hospital, an indiscretion about the past puts Ander in a tough spot.

episodes.title: Parte 2
episodes.summary: Ander tries to cheer up Alexis and take his mind off things by inviting him to a barbecue at Rebeka's new place.

episodes.title: Parte 3
episodes.summary: After a heart-to-heart with Ander, Alexis makes a final decision about his treatment.
